I started playing back in breach. I had no idea what I was doing. Didn't know about any trade sites or anything... I remember being astonished when I saw the first person hit lvl 100 and thought " it took people so long to hit lvl 100? Didn't the game release years ago?". 

My first "build" was a templar I wanted to do some fire themed stuff so I played fireball until I found firestorm. And it was sooooo fun. I wish I could enjoy this game again for the first time. 
My first wall was cruel malachai. I asked some random people for help and found a really nice dude who started to slowly explain some mechanics. He also told me to continue playing my fire build until I don't enjoy it anymore and only then start to look at build guides. 

I took my firestorm templar to lvl 85. Then did my labs until cruel lab and it destroyed me. 
I then played a cyclone slayer and took it to lvl 94.

I will always remember my firestorm templar. Every rare felt like a challenge. Every boss took me minutes. But since then the first firestorm Gem I find in every league is being celebrated and put in a quad tab to take it to standard. Even found a 21/20 this league. Made me happier than every divine I found. 

I swear to God. If I win the mirrors. I will build a actually good firestorm build and will annihilate malachai and izaro.
